history_matches.denominator: valid prior history positions; empty history yields zero
history_matches.author_rule: raw author IDs >= 0, independent of embedding frequency threshold
history_matches.tag_rule: any shared known tag (>1) marks one matching history position

feature_rules: Untrained user/scene IDs map to zero; untrained item IDs use zero embedding and retain known tags

S0.note: Fixed initial smoothing, not tuned. Constant within user and scenario; no item discrimination.
